deepseek.name: Blue Big Fish
deepseek.tagline: Gentle, with a little clever spark.
deepseek.description: Happy to hear you out, then help sort a thought in an easy way. Serious when it matters, and still a little playful.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.tagline: Let curiosity take you a little further.
gemini.description: Always curious about something new. Even a small question can open a few unexpected possibilities.

claude.name: Claude
claude.description: Does not rush an answer. Hears you out first, then helps untangle a complicated thought with careful attention.

grok.name: Grok
grok.tagline: A little mischief makes the chat more fun.
grok.description: Lively, with a sly edge. Quick to reply, and happy to toss in an unexpected take.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.tagline: Listen calmly. Make the idea clear.
chatgpt.description: Takes in different ideas without hurry and says a tangled question clearly. Warm encouragement, and willing to work through it with you.

kimi.name: Kimi
kimi.tagline: Keeps your story carefully in mind.
kimi.description: A quiet night reader who remembers the small things you mentioned. Patient listening, a dry joke, and thoughts that become a story.

qwen.name: Qwen
qwen.tagline: An old story can still be told a new way.
qwen.description: A gentle bookshop keeper who treasures old stories and still hears new ideas. Thoughtful in the everyday, with room left for surprise.
